description_en: Queries a list of attack events
description_zh: 调用DescribeDdosAllEventList查询攻击事件列表
name: DescribeDdosAllEventList

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.
The end time must be later than the start time. The maximum time range that can be queried is 31 days
parameters.help_zh:
结束时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。
结束时间需大于起始时间。开始结束时间跨度最长不超过31天
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The type of DDoS attack events to query. Valid values:

- web-cc: web resource exhaustion attacks.

- cc: connection flood attacks.

- traffic: volumetric attacks.

If you do not set this parameter, all types of attack events are queried
parameters.help_zh:
待查询的DDoS攻击事件的类型。取值：
- web-cc：表示Web资源耗尽型攻击。
- cc：表示连接型攻击。
- traffic：表示流量型攻击。


不设置该参数表示查询所有类型的攻击事件
parameters.name: event_type

parameters.help_en: The page number. Default value: 1. Valid values: 1 to 100000
parameters.help_zh: 页码，默认值为1。取值范围：1-100000
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Valid values: 5, 10, and 20
parameters.name: page_size

Bps.description_en: The peak BPS of the volumetric attack

Cps.description_en: The peak CPS of the connection flood attack

EndTime.description_en:
The end of the time range.
The time is in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
EndTime.description_zh:
结束时间。
日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

EventType.description_en:
The type of the DDoS attack event. Valid values:

web-cc: a web resource exhaustion attack.

cc: a connection flood attack.

traffic: a volumetric attack.

If this parameter is not set, all types of attack events are returned
EventType.description_zh:
待查询的DDoS攻击事件的类型。取值：
web-cc：表示Web资源耗尽型攻击。
cc：表示连接型攻击。
traffic：表示流量型攻击。
不设置该参数表示查询所有类型的攻击事件

Pps.description_en: The peak PPS of the volumetric attack

Qps.description_en: The peak queries per second (QPS) of the web resource exhaustion attack

StartTime.description_en: The beginning of the time range. The time is in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
StartTime.description_zh: 开始时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Valid values: 5, 10, and 20

Total.description_en: The total number of entries returned
